overview.description: The AllianzIM U.S. Equity Buffer100 Protection ETF (AIOO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to track the share price returns of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (ticker: SPY) up to a specific participation rate, while fully hedging downside risk, over a three-month outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options. AIOO was launched on Jun 30, 2025 and is issued by Allianz.
